messages:
taylor: Heads up team 12: webinar + launch post + benchmark landing next Wed. Need a short SEO playbook: canonical strategy, redirects for legacy benchmarks, schema selection (Event + Breadcrumb + FAQ), internal linking plan, and inbound lead routing to sales. Can we split tasks?

nina: I can take schema + structured data testing. Thinking Event + FAQ + BreadcrumbList. Also consider Speakable for the blog summary card.

omar: I'll map redirects. Proposal: 301 for content moved permanently, 307 for staged pages, and 410 for retired proofs-of-concept. Need the list of legacy slugs.

ranjit: I'll handle internal-link changes and update the editorial style (H2s with target keywords). Want the benchmark anchor `#key-takeaways` on every related page to funnel to signup.

seo-bot: site_audit: found missing canonical on /benchmark/latency-v2, missing Event.startDate on /events/low-latency, mobile viewport warnings on 2 pages, and broken image og:image on /blog/old-latency-case.

nina: Example JSON-LD I'll add to the webinar page (minimal):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Low-latency Inference: Benchmarks & Best Practices","startDate":"2026-05-12T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/low-latency-2026","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/low-latency-2026"}}
```
I'll also include FAQ structured data for the signup and a BreadcrumbList on the benchmark pages.

omar: Redirect rules draft: `/benchmarks/latency-old` -> `/benchmark/latency-2026` (301), `/webinar-old` -> `/webinars/low-latency-2026` (307 until May 20), `/case-studies/latency-experiments` -> 410. I'll drop CSV in the shared folder.

ranjit: For internal links: landing -> benchmark -> methodology -> docs -> signup. We should add contextual CTAs in three places: top banner (sticky), mid-article pull quote, and final CTA with dataLayer push. Also add rel="noopener noreferrer" on external links.

taylor: How about canonical policy? Keep canonical to the canonicalized landing under `/benchmark/latency-2026` for derivative posts. Also generate link rel=alternate hreflang entries if we roll out translations later.

ash: FYI HubSpot routing: set a hidden field `origin_funnel=benchmark_launch` and route to queue `gql-webinars`. Also add a workflow that pings sales with lead score > 30.

ranjit: One more: Lighthouse flagged slow LCP on the benchmark page due to a big hero image. Recommend responsive `srcset` + preconnect to CDN and `link rel=preload` for the hero.

nina: Good call. Also ensure JSON-LD is server-rendered (not injected by client JS) so Search Console picks it up reliably. If the site is SPA we need SSR or pre-rendering for the webinar JSON-LD.

omar: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/seo/redirects/latency-2026-map.csv

taylor: Timeline: redirects mapped + staging deploy by Fri EOD, schema snippets merged and SSR verified by Mon, OG images and preload by Tue, routing + analytics QA Wed morning.

seo-bot: action_items: sitemap_update required (add new benchmark URL), disallow none, robots ok. Also suggests adding OpenGraph and Twitter card meta to benchmark and webinar pages.

ranjit: I'll add anchor links and update the editorial doc with keyword targets: primary 'low latency inference', secondary 'latency per token', long-tail 'reducing inference tail latency for chat models'.

ash: HubSpot note: preserve inbound query params through redirect so `utm_campaign` and `utm_source` are intact. We'll need server-side pass-through.

omar: Confirmed nginx rewrite will keep query string. Example: `return 301 https://redwood.ai/benchmark/latency-2026$request_uri;` We'll test on staging.

taylor: Quick checklist: 1) Redirect CSV in drive (omar) 2) JSON-LD (nina) 3) Internal link map (ranjit) 4) HubSpot routing + dataLayer (ash) 5) Preload/OG images (ranjit).

nina: After deploy I'll run Rich Results test and Search Console inspection to validate Event markup and FAQ.

ash: I'll set up GTM trigger for `webinar_signup` and a GA4 event `webinar_registration` with `funnel_source` param. Invite sent for QA Thu 11am PT.

omar: Deploying redirects to staging now, will post results and a short diff for the CSV.

taylor: Thanks all. If any edge cases (amp pages, docs redirects) flag them here. We'll do a final sweep in the QA slot. :rocket:
